Meta Test Description: The test prints a greeting, reads from 0xA0000000 and 0xA001706C using read_reg() and logs the values, writes 0xDEADBEEF to 0xA0240000 with write_reg(), reads back from 0xA0240000 and logs the value, then calls finish(0). There are no conditional checks or assertions.

Test Description: Initializes the USB controller in host mode and performs low-speed device enumeration using interrupts: configures global, PHY/PIPE, command/event ring, and context registers; runs the controller, resets the port, enables a slot and addresses the device; drives EP0 control transfers to get and set configuration; validates progress via interrupt status and event ring updates.
Meta Test Description: The test enables platform IRQs, programs controller global registers (MIZAR_USB_GCTL, MIZAR_USB_GFLADJ, MIZAR_USB_GUCTL), PIPE control at MIZAR_USB_BASE+0xc2c0 and PHY control at MIZAR_USB_BASE+0xc200, reads capabilities/port (MIZAR_USB_HCSPARAMS1, MIZAR_USB_SUPTPRT2_DW2, MIZAR_USB_SUPTPRT3_DW2, MIZAR_USB_PORTSC_20), enables port write-change bits, sets initial PORTSC, reads MIZAR_USB_DBOFF, configures Event Ring Segment Table and size, reads MIZAR_USB_HCSPARAMS2 and MIZAR_USB_PAGESIZE, sets Scratchpad Buffer Array and DCBAA (MIZAR_USB_DCBAAP_LO/HI), sets command ring (MIZAR_USB_CRCR_LO/HI), configures MIZAR_USB_CONFIG (incl. CIE), programs interrupter and run/stop (MIZAR_USB_IMOD, MIZAR_USB_IMAN, MIZAR_USB_USBCMD) and system INTR_EN0, then waits for ISR completion via polling. It services MIZAR_USB_USBSTS, re-arms MIZAR_USB_IMAN, updates MIZAR_USB_ERDP_HI/LO, reads MIZAR_USB_PORTSC_20, issues a port reset by writing MIZAR_USB_PORTSC_20 and waits for interrupts again. It builds an Enable Slot command TRB on Default_Command_Ring, advances ERDP to consume completion, sets MIZAR_USB_PORTSC_20 and rings MIZAR_USB_DB. It initializes Default Input Context (control and EP0; TR dequeue pointers), writes Address Device command TRBs to Default_Command_Ring and rings doorbell, waiting for completions by polling Event Ring entries with ERDP updates. The enumeration() routine programs EP0 TRB sequences for GET Device Descriptor, GET Configuration, SET Configuration, and additional GETs, rings doorbell at MIZAR_USB_BASE+0x484, and polls Default_Event_Ring_Array+0x110 for completion. The ISR clears RAW_STCR0, acknowledges IMAN/USBSTS, and clears the GIC/MSK_STS0. Upon successful completions, the test calls finish(0).
Remarks: Enable controller interrupts (IMAN) and set controller run/stop (USBCMD). Ensure a USB device is connected so PORTSC indicates device present. Program DCBAAP, ERSTBA, and ERDP to valid buffers before issuing commands.
Test Steps / Procedure: 1) Enable platform interrupts and initialize the USB controller for host operation. 2) Configure controller global timing/control and PHY/PIPE settings. 3) Read capabilities and port status, enable port write-change actions, and set initial port state. 4) Initialize the event ring (segment table, size, and dequeue pointer). 5) Initialize device contexts, scratchpads, and the Device Context Base Address Array. 6) Configure the command ring and controller configuration; enable controller interrupts and set the controller to run. 7) Service initial interrupts and verify status is cleared; advance the event dequeue pointer as needed. 8) Reset the port and confirm state changes via interrupts. 9) Issue the Enable Slot command and confirm completion on the event ring. 10) Build the default input context and issue the Address Device command; confirm completion on the event ring. 11) Perform EP0 control transfers (GET descriptors and SET configuration); ring doorbells and verify event completions. 12) Conclude when all expected completions occur without errors.
